# Button

Starts an action; primary (wx-btn-primary, brand fill, on-brand text) at most once per view — usually «Порівняти вихідні» or the search submit.

`WeatherExplorer.Button` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<WeatherExplorer.Button>…</WeatherExplorer.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="WeatherExplorer.Button">…</x-import>
```
